item.title: Fall '26 Week 1
item.description: Resources Slides Video Script Hello, and welcome to the week one announcements video for CIS 527 and CC Fall 10 in fall 2026. Once again, my name is Russ Feldhausen. I’ll be your instructor for the semester. Um, maybe at this point you’ve watched the course introduction video. I just got done recording that. Um, that video is scripted for the most part, and so you’ll get a more robotic version of me in that video. Um, these announcements videos are not scripted. Um, all I do is I write my slides ahead of time, and then I work my way through the slides. So you’ll see a little bit more authentic version of me in these announcements. Um, I highly, highly recommend watching these announcements every time I post them because they have the most recent information and the things that are front of mind for me as I’m going through this class. So if you have any questions for me, feel free to reach out anytime. My email is here. Uh, you can find me on Ed Discussion, on Teams, on Discord. I’m pretty easy to get a hold of, uh, especially because I work from home most of the time. Uh, so feel free to reach out anytime if you have any questions.

item.title: Fall '26 Week 2
item.description: Resources Slides Video Script 00:00 Hello and welcome to the week two announcements for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So hopefully you’re getting started working on Lab 1. Lab 1 is going to be due, I believe, next week sometime. So make sure you’re getting that worked on. For grading in this class, we do, for a lot of these labs, we’re going to do an in-person grading via Zoom. So the way this works is to get your lab graded. You schedule a time slot via our Calendly links. Please look at Sicheng’s Calendly link first than mine. I will get Sicheng’s posted later today so that it’s on the syllabus and on the homepage. If Sicheng is available, I’d prefer that you schedule with Sicheng first. If not, feel free to schedule with me. What you’re going to do is you’re going to make snapshots of your VMs and have those booted and ready to go when you connect to the Zoom. And then I or Sicheng is going to walk you through the things that we need to see on the rubric. You should know how to show us those things. So if we ask you, show us how all the user accounts that you created or show us that this user account is in this group or show us the permissions for these files, you should know how to do that. The lab has all of that in there.

item.title: Fall '26 Week 12
item.description: Resources Slides Video Script [00:00] Hello and welcome to the week 12 announcements video for CIS 527 and CC 510 in fall 2026. So this week you should be working on lab six. The quizzes for that are due Friday. We’ll have our fifth and final discussion session with the guest speaker next Wednesday. And then lab six will be due next Friday. So you’ll want to make sure you get that scheduled for grading before Thanksgiving. However, if you do notice that the week after that is Thanksgiving break. So if you wait all the way until the Monday after Thanksgiving break, there will just be a one day late penalty on lab six grading. So just keep that in mind. But lab six is due indeed a week from Friday. So lab six, we’re going to do a few things. We’re going to do file servers and drive mappings on both Windows and Linux. We’re also going to do some application server stuff on Windows and your Linux in the Cloud, and we’ll do some stuff working with web apps there as well. This one we’re going to jump around between different setups of the labs, but hopefully everything works out well for this. For those of you using Azure, you’ll be using your Windows servers in Azure a little bit for this for the file servers, drive mappings, and web apps. Once you get Lab 6 graded, that’s all we’re going to do with Windows server, so you can decommission those Azure things as soon as you get them graded on Lab 6. So if you’re concerned with that, you can work through Lab 6 pretty quickly and get that graded soon. The DigitalOcean stuff we’ll use through Lab 6 and Lab 7. So like I said, for lab seven, we’re going to have some stuff on backups. We’re going to do a little bit on monitoring and logging, and we’ll do an activity on DevOps dealing with some webhooks. So be prepared for that as well.
